title: Operators and Expressions
goal: Arithmetic se bitwise tak har operator, precedence/associativity aur short-circuit evaluation ko samajhna.
definition: Operator ek symbol hai jo operands par operation karta hai aur expression banata hai. C me arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment, increment/decrement, bitwise, conditional, comma aur sizeof operators hain.
explain: Arithmetic (+ - * / %) integer operands par integer division karta hai: 7/2 = 3. % sirf integers par chalta hai aur negative numbers par sign dividend ka hota hai (-7 % 3 = -1).
Relational (< > <= >= == !=) 0 ya 1 dete hain. Assignment = aur comparison == alag hain — if (x = 5) hamesha true hota hai, compiler warning deta hai.
Logical && aur || short-circuit karte hain: agar left side se answer pata chal gaya to right side evaluate hi nahi hota. Isliye p && p->next safe hai.
Bitwise (& | ^ ~ << >>) bits par kaam karte hain — flags, masks, fast multiply/divide. Right shift signed negative par implementation-defined hai; unsigned par zero-fill.
Increment/decrement me prefix (++i: pehle badhao) aur postfix (i++: pehle use karo) ka fark hai. Ek hi expression me variable ko do baar modify karna UB hai.
analogy: Expression ek kitchen recipe hai jisme operations ka order fixed hai — pehle brackets, phir multiply, phir add. Precedence wahi order hai; associativity batati hai same level par left ya right se chalo.
why: Kisi bhi language ka logic yahin banta hai: conditions, loops, masks aur flags. Precedence ki galti se silently galat result aata hai — jo crash se zyada khatarnak hai.

syntax.note: Integer division truncate karta hai; cast se float division.

syntax.code:
int flags = 0b1010;      /* C23; C17 me 0xA */
flags |= 0x1;            /* set bit 0 */
flags &= ~0x2;           /* clear bit 1 */
if (flags & 0x8) { }     /* test bit 3 */
printf("%d\n", flags << 1);

topics.title: Arithmetic aur modulus
topics.body: + - * / %; integer division truncate karti hai. % integers ke liye, sign dividend ka. Overflow signed par UB, unsigned par wrap. Division/modulus by zero UB hai — check karo.

topics.title: Relational aur logical
topics.body: == != < <= > >= 0/1 dete hain. && || ! short-circuit karte hain, precedence: ! > && > ||. if (a == b) aur if (!strcmp(a,b)) ke semantics alag hain — strcmp 0 par equal.

topics.title: Assignment aur increment
topics.body: =, +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, &=, |=, ^=, <<=, >>=. Prefix ++i value badhne ke baad deta hai; postfix i++ purani value deta hai. Side effects ka order unspecified ho to UB.

topics.title: Bitwise aur shifts
topics.body: & | ^ ~ << >>. x << 1 = x*2 (overflow UB), unsigned >> zero-fill, signed negative >> implementation-defined. Mask: value & 0xFF; toggle: ^= 1. Enum flags ke liye ideal.

topics.title: Precedence, associativity, comma
topics.body: Brackets sabse pehle, phir unary, * / %, + -, shifts, relational, equality, bitwise, &&, ||, ?:, assignment, comma. Assignment right-associative; comma left-to-right evaluate karke last value deta hai. Confusion ho to brackets lagao.

examples.title: Arithmetic aur integer division
lines: a + b, a - b, a * b argument order me print hote hain.

examples.title: Bit flags aur short-circuit
lines: n != 0 false hai, isliye 10/n evaluate hi nahi hua — divide by zero se bacha.
Ternary condition ke hisaab se 42 deta hai.

mistakes.why: Assignment expression 5 deta hai jo truthy hai — condition hamesha true.
Integer division decimals kho deti hai.
Ek expression me i ko do baar modify karna UB hai.

debug.brief: Average 3 aa raha hai 3.5 ki jagah. Fix karo.

best: == aur = ka dhyan rakho; -Wparentheses on karo
Division se pehle zero check karo

practice.title: Calculator
practice.prompt: Do numbers aur operator (+ - * /) lekar result print karo.

practice.title: Swap
practice.prompt: Do variables ko temp ke bina XOR se swap karo.
practice.hint: a ^= b; b ^= a; a ^= b;

mcqs.explain: C99 se result ka sign dividend (7) ka hota hai, isliye 1.
Left false ho to right evaluate nahi hota.
Postfix increment purani value return karta hai, prefix nayi.

interview.a: Null check ke saath dereference: if (p != NULL && p->value > 0) — pehla false ho to dereference hi nahi hota. Isi tarah divide-by-zero guard.
interview.followUp: Bitwise & se kyun nahi? — wo dono sides evaluate karta hai.

interview.q: Signed overflow aur unsigned overflow me fark?
interview.a: Signed overflow undefined behaviour hai (compiler assume kar sakta hai kabhi nahi hoga); unsigned arithmetic modulo 2^N wrap karti hai, defined hai.
interview.followUp: Overflow detect kaise? — __builtin_add_overflow ya wider type.

interview.q: Precedence table yaad rakhna zaroori hai?
interview.a: Core order yaad rakho (unary → multiplicative → additive → shift → relational → equality → bitwise → logical → conditional → assignment) aur baaki brackets se clear karo — galat precedence silent bug deta hai.
interview.followUp: a & b == 0 ka matlab? — == pehle chalta hai, isliye a & (b==0).
